name: Tharil'zun
summary: Near Stonewatch Keep, Marshal Marris puts a bounty on Tharil'zun, whose outrunners harass the roads. His death is a critical step in breaking the Blackrock clan's hold over northern Redridge, and his severed head brought to Lakeshire marks a hard-fought victory for its watch.

sections.title: The Road to Stonewatch
sections.body: The pass between Lakeshire and Stonewatch Keep has become a gauntlet of sudden ambushes. Blackrock outrunners and renegades prowl the rocky ridges, cutting off scouts and threatening reinforcements trying to reach the fortress. Marshal Marris names Tharil'zun as the commander behind these coordinated strikes. He says Tharil'zun must be eliminated, or Lakeshire may be hemmed in entirely.

sections.title: Decapitating the Outrunners
sections.body: Tharil'zun is a dangerous battlefield leader: vicious, crafty, and able to unite scattered orc raiders into an effective raiding force. To take his head in Stonewatch's shadow, you must cut through entrenched Blackrock outposts. His death breaks the outrunner patrols' cohesion and clears a path for the Alliance to face the garrison inside the keep.

faq.answer: Tharil'zun is a formidable Blackrock orc commander who leads the outrunners and renegades ambushing trails between Lakeshire and Stonewatch Keep.
Tharil'zun is near Stonewatch Keep in northeastern Redridge, commanding outrunners who patrol the surrounding passes and outposts.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Marris want his head?
faq.answer: Marris sees Tharil'zun as the cunning tactician directing the ambushes that harass Redridge. He demands Tharil'zun's head to sever the outrunner leadership and prove the threat has been eliminated.

faq.q: What happens after Tharil'zun is defeated?
faq.answer: Defeating Tharil'zun cripples the outrunners' coordination, allowing Lakeshire's defenders and adventurers to push deeper into Stonewatch Keep and confront the main Blackrock garrison.

faq.q: Why are Blackrock orcs in Redridge Mountains?
aliases: why are blackrock orcs in redridge
faq.answer: Blackrock clan remnants moved south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge. They fortified old human outposts such as Stonewatch Keep to threaten the Eastern Kingdoms while Stormwind's military is stretched thin.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before hunting Tharil'zun?
faq.answer: Before Marshal Marris sends you after Tharil'zun, he requires you to prove your mettle by thinning the invading forces in 'Blackrock Menace'.

angles.text: Lakeshire stands largely isolated, without direct reinforcements from Stormwind. The bounty on Tharil'zun is a vital local measure to keep the town from being besieged.
As a human, the Blackrock presence in Redridge recalls the First and Second Wars. Slaying Tharil'zun reclaims ground stolen from the kingdom.
As an orc, you face Tharil'zun, one of the Old Horde's dark remnants under the Blackrock banner, serving masters who reject Thrall's new order across the sea.
